antes.Fees: The desk's fee on the gross premium of each weekly call the vault sells (20% at launch), fixed at the sale and recognized one hour later when the Safe can no longer void the sale; a voided sale charges no fee. The premium itself is not counted as fees: it is the buyer's payment for the option, which depositors carry against the risk of the call settling in the money (see the options adapter's premium volume). A call sold outside the desk (not possible with the current operator) counts the fee the operator reports at settlement.
antes.Revenue: All of the desk fee on the gross premium of each weekly call the vault sells, paid to the HedgeHood treasury Safe at settlement.
antes.ProtocolRevenue: All of the desk fee on the gross premium of each weekly call the vault sells, paid to the HedgeHood treasury Safe at settlement.

despues.Fees: The protocol's fee on the gross premium of each option the vaults sell (20% at launch). v1 vault (NVDA Printer): fixed at the sale and recognized one hour later when the Safe can no longer void the sale; a voided sale charges no fee; a call sold outside the desk (not possible with the current operator) counts the fee the operator reports at settlement. v2 and v2.1 funds (Robinhood Chain and BNB Chain): the premium stays escrowed in the fund until the epoch settles, so the fee is counted at settlement, as the fund reports it (EpochSettled.fee); voided positions and unpriced settlements charge none. The premium itself is not counted as fees: it is the buyer's payment for the option, which depositors carry against the risk of the option settling in the money (see the options adapter's premium volume).

despues.UserFees: Percentage of rewards paid to protocol
despues.Fees: Total rewards generated from ether.fi staking services: ETH staking, Eigenlayer restaking, validator operations
despues.Revenue: Protocol's share of fees including management fees from staking/restaking and validator operations rewards
despues.ProtocolRevenue: ether.fi's share of staking, restaking and validator rewards, plus eETH withdrawal fees, all kept by the protocol treasury.
despues.SupplySideRevenue: Portion of fees distributed to stakers.
despues.HoldersRevenue: ETHFI bought back on the open market by ether.fi's treasury, plus monthly off-chain buybacks from July 2024 to April 2025; excludes ETHFI bought since September 2026 to fund ether.fi Cash cashback, which the ether.fi Cash listing counts as a cost.

antes.UserFees: Users pay the 0.25% cash-out fee, taken from the amount they cash out.
antes.Fees: A 0.25% fee on every cash-out from the Gloam shielded pool. Deposits and private payments are free.
antes.Revenue: All cash-out fees go to the Gloam fee recipient.
antes.ProtocolRevenue: All cash-out fees go to the Gloam fee recipient.

despues.UserFees: Users pay the 0.5% cash-out fee, taken from the amount they cash out.
despues.Fees: A 0.5% fee on every cash-out from the Gloam shielded pool. Deposits and private payments are free.
despues.Revenue: All cash-out fees go to the Gloam fee recipient.
despues.ProtocolRevenue: All cash-out fees go to the Gloam fee recipient.

despues.UserFees: Pack sales minus the USDC paid to users who sell their cards back.
despues.Fees: Pack sales minus the USDC paid to users who sell their cards back.
despues.Revenue: Jupiter's share of gacha fees, negative on days when buybacks exceed sales.
despues.ProtocolRevenue: All of Jupiter's share, kept by Jupiter. Not used for JUP buybacks.
despues.SupplySideRevenue: Gacha fees not kept by Jupiter, kept by Collector Crypt and Phygitals.

despues.Fees: wstO taken from every swap in wstO/launch-token pairs and burned, valued as the O it redeems for in that chain's vault.
despues.Revenue: No swap burn fees are retained as protocol revenue; all accrue to vault stakers.
despues.ProtocolRevenue: No swap fees go to the o1.exchange treasury.
despues.SupplySideRevenue: All wstO swap burn fees accrue to vault stakers through a higher O redemption value per remaining wstO share.
despues.HoldersRevenue: No swap burn fees are classified as governance-token holder revenue; vault staker income is supply-side revenue.

despues.Fees: Total fees paid by users for bridge and swap txs.
despues.Revenue: Protocol revenue is currently 0.
despues.ProtocolRevenue: Pheasant Network currently takes no protocol fee.
despues.SupplySideRevenue: All fees paid by users go to the relayers.
despues.HoldersRevenue: Revenue distributed to token holders is currently 0.
